propositions: AGENTS.md incorrectly states the close precheck requires a MERGED commit reachable from HEAD, when it actually accepts any commit (merged or not) reachable from HEAD that references the ticket or any transitive descendant.
The close precheck is conditional on recorded file_impact and the completion-verification gate being enabled, not unconditional as stated in the documentation.
AGENTS.md and CONTRIBUTING.md omit documentation of rebar transition --ref, which allows closing a stacked story against its own commit without moving the worktree.
The ordering rule enforcing land-before-close is the Verified +1 policy, not the referencing-commit precheck mechanism as the current documentation implies.
The --ref flag retargets completion verification and signature to a specified ref's tree but does not narrow the referencing-commit scan, which always runs git log with no ref argument.
